test_title: PYST 60: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  On 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

When I went to Egypt and lost my wallet and passport, I was _____________.

options.text: putting my nose to the grindstone
working my fingers to the bone
up in a creek without a paddle

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"up a creek without a paddle"** means to be in a difficult or troublesome situation without a solution or way out. (मुसीबत में फंसना) • **Example:** After losing his job and his car breaking down, John felt like he was up a creek without a paddle. • **"Rolling up my sleeves"** refers to preparing to work hard or tackle a difficult task. (कड़ी मेहनत के लिए तैयार होना) • **Example:** With the project deadline approaching, everyone in the team was rolling up their sleeves to get the work done on time. • **"Putting my nose to the grindstone"** means to work hard and continuously. (लगातार कड़ी मेहनत करना) • **Example:** She put her nose to the grindstone and studied for hours to prepare for the exam. • **"Working my fingers to the bone"** means to work extremely hard. (बहुत मेहनत करना) • **Example:** He worked his fingers to the bone to provide for his family. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Rolling up my sleeves** (कड़ी मेहनत के लिए तैयार होना): Preparing to work hard or tackle a difficult task. • **Example:** With the project deadline approaching, everyone in the team was rolling up their sleeves to get the work done on time. • **Putting my nose to the grindstone** (लगातार कड़ी मेहनत करना): To work hard and continuously. • **Example:** She put her nose to the grindstone and studied for hours to prepare for the exam. • **Working my fingers to the bone** (बहुत मेहनत करना): To work extremely hard. • **Example:** He worked his fingers to the bone to provide for his family. 4f:Tbe3, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
